questions.question: Which Chicago neighborhood or community area has the highest count of listed affordable rental properties?
questions.program:

questions.question: Which entity manages the Senior Suites of Bridgeport development at 2825 S. Halsted St.?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('chicago_affordable_rental_housing.csv')
row = df[df['Address'] == '2825 S. Halsted St.']

questions.question: Are there more affordable developments listed in Uptown than in North Lawndale?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('chicago_affordable_rental_housing.csv')
uptown = (df['Community Area Name'] == 'Uptown').sum()
lawndale = (df['Community Area Name'] == 'North Lawndale').sum()
result = 'yes' if uptown > lawndale else 'no'
